unit.title: Measures
unit.blurb: Comparing length, height, mass and capacity using words like longer, taller, heavier and full; measuring with cubes.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Compare and measure lengths and heights.

p: We compare things with words like **longer**, **shorter**, **taller**. Line them up at one end to compare fairly.
We can measure how long something is by counting how many **cubes** fit along it.

vocab.def: find out how long or heavy

p: An object that is harder to lift is **heavier**. On a **balance**, the heavier side goes **down**.
A cup is **full** when no more will fit. It is **empty** when there is nothing in it. **Half full** is in between.

options.fb: Half full has some in it.
Full means no more fits in.
